verdict.rationale: Docs confirm physical Issuing cards are created via API, printed/shipped, customizable with company logo/branding, and replaceable — all without needing a direct card manufacturer relationship (docs-2, docs-7, docs-8, docs-17). However, the evidence pack has no explicit mention of bulk ordering workflows, selectable shipping methods, or shipment tracking details. Missing for 10: bulk order API/batch issuance evidence, shipping method options, tracking number/status evidence.
